memories.author: D06
memories.text: allergy: penicillin; reaction: rash and angioedema after amoxicillin course 2023.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: independent with ADLs, walks 20 mins daily, uses stick occasionally. cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal). falls: 0 falls last 12 months, gait steady, TUG 10 sec (normal). medicines: 8 regular (clobetasol, calcipotriol, methotrexate, folic acid, pantoprazole, antacid gel SOS, domperidone, cetirizine, fluticasone, montelukast) – polypharmacy, review Beers criteria. mood: reports occasional frustration with skin lesions, denies depression. carers: daughter Priya, lives nearby. goals: "I want to keep my garden and teach my grandchildren."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: clobetasol 0.05% cream BD topical to plaques; calcipotriol ointment OD topical; methotrexate 7.5 mg PO once weekly; folic acid 5 mg OD; pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast; antacid gel SOS after meals; domperidone 10 mg BD before meals; cetirizine 10 mg HS; fluticasone nasal spray 1 spray each nostril OD; montelukast 10 mg HS.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: LFT: ALT 32 U/L (7-56), AST 28 U/L (10-40), ALP 78 U/L (40-130), GGT 32 U/L (0-51). CBC: Hb 12.8 g/L (12-16), WBC 6.2 x10^9/L (4-10), Plt 210 x10^9/L (150-400). Creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (0.6-1.1). H. pylori stool antigen: negative. Total serum IgE: 120 IU/mL (<100 borderline).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Skin prick test: positive reaction to house dust mite (3+ wheal), grass pollen (2+), negative to cat dander. Interpretation: allergic rhinitis likely dust mite driven.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Refer to Dermatology, St. John's Hospital for refractory psoriasis despite topicals and low-dose methotrexate. Request assessment for biologic therapy and phototherapy.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Dermatology letter: Psoriasis PASI 12. Recommend continuing methotrexate, consider adding acitretin 25 mg OD. Phototherapy available. Review in 6 weeks.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via app: Nasal congestion improved after starting fluticasone, still occasional sneezing on waking. No new skin lesions.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up geriatrics appointment booked for 2025-07-05 at 10:30 AM with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: ADLs independent, garden work tolerated, mild knee pain after walking. cognition: not screened this visit (annual due Apr 2026). falls: 0 falls, gait slightly antalgic left, TUG 11 sec (borderline). medicines: 8 regular, polypharmacy – discuss Beers review. mood: reports improved skin, less itching. carers: daughter Priya. goals: "I want to walk pain‑free to the market."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: methotrexate reduced to 5 mg PO once weekly; folic acid 5 mg OD unchanged; all other meds as before.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: LFT: ALT 28, AST 24, ALP 70, GGT 30. CBC: Hb 13.0, WBC 5.9, Plt 205. Creatinine 0.88.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Resting ECG: sinus rhythm 78 bpm, no ST‑T changes, normal intervals. No ischemia.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: walks 30 mins with stick, reports occasional back stiffness. cognition: not due. falls: 0 falls, gait steady, TUG 10.5 sec (normal). medicines: 7 regular (methotrexate 5 mg weekly), polypharmacy threshold met – review Beers. mood: stable. carers: daughter Priya. goals: "I want to travel to Mysore for the festival."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Add topical calcipotriol‑betamethasone combo BD to plaques; continue clobetasol only on thick patches. All other meds unchanged.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: LFT: ALT 22, AST 20, ALP 68, GGT 28. CBC: Hb 13.2, WBC 6.1, Plt 210. Creatinine 0.86. Serum uric acid 5.8 mg/dL (normal).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: independent, gardening daily, no joint pain. cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (recall 2, clock draw mild abnormality) – negative screen (<=2 would be positive). falls: 0 falls, gait normal, TUG 9.8 sec. medicines: 7 regular, polypharmacy – discuss Beers review. mood: reports good sleep, no low mood. carers: daughter Priya. goals: "I want to see my great‑grandchild’s first steps."
